\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\definecolor{mygreen}{HTML}{006400}
\newcommand{\measurebox}[2]{%

  \typeout{INLINE-BOX #1: w=\the\wd0, h=\the\ht0, d=\the\dp0}}

\measurebox{stop}{\tikz[baseline]{\node[rectangle,fill=red,inner sep=.3mm,anchor=base]{\textcolor{white}{\tt STOP}};}}
\measurebox{descenders}{\tt A\tikz[baseline]{\node[rectangle,fill=red,inner xsep=2pt,inner ysep=1pt,anchor=base]{\textcolor{white}{gp}};}B}
\measurebox{center}{\tt A\tikz[baseline]{\node[rectangle,fill=red,inner sep=1pt]{\textcolor{white}{gp}};}B}
\measurebox{default-sep}{\tt A\tikz[baseline]{\node[rectangle,fill=red,anchor=base]{\textcolor{white}{gp}};}B}
